name: 01 - Client Intake & Compliance Gate
description: Credit repair client intake workflow with CROA compliance gate, 3-day cancellation window, and Postgres case insertion. Webhook: POST /webhook/credit-repair/intake

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO cases (case_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, ssn_last4, street, city, state, zip, plan_tier, credit_data_source, case_status, cancellation_deadline, consent_given, contract_signed, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.case_id }}', '{{ $json.first_name }}', '{{ $json.last_name }}',
  '{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.phone }}', '{{ $json.date_of_birth }}',
  '{{ $json.ssn_last4 }}', '{{ $json.street }}', '{{ $json.city }}',
  '{{ $json.state }}', '{{ $json.zip }}', '{{ $json.plan_tier }}',
  '{{ $json.credit_data_source }}', '{{ $json.case_status }}',
  '{{ $json.cancellation_deadline }}'::timestamptz, true, true,
  '{{ $json.intake_received_at }}'::timestamptz
)
RETURNING case_id, case_status, cancellation_deadline;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "accepted", case_id: $json.case_id, message: "Intake received. Your 3-day cancellation window is now open.", cancellation_deadline: $json.cancellation_deadline }) }}

assignments.name: reason
assignments.value: ={{ $json._missing.length ? 'Missing required fields: ' + $json._missing.join(', ') : 'Consent, disclosure acknowledgement, and a signed services contract are required.' }}
